title: harness.json plugins.arc-straps
description: The arc-straps section of <project>/.claude/harness.json. Every key is optional; plugins/arc-straps/config/defaults.json fills the rest.

atbx.description: Toolbox archive (.atbx); null means the one .atbx at the project root.

tool_dir.description: Folder of canonical per-tool help XML, <Tool>.xml.

toolbox_source.description: Toolbox-level help XML; null means <parent of tool_dir>/<archive file name, extension included>.xml (e.g. Tools.atbx.xml).

registry.description: Optional tool registry JSON {"tools": [{"tool_name", "py_path"}]} for the stale-path check; null skips it.

atbx.description: Toolbox archive (.atbx); null means the one .atbx at the project root. Set apart from arc_meta.atbx; this section never reads arc_meta.

tool_dir.description: Folder of canonical per-tool help XML, <Tool>.xml. Set apart from arc_meta.tool_dir; this section never reads arc_meta.

help_dir.description: Folder of the tracked help pages, <page>.html (the fragment stem, usually the tool name), with _fragments/, _template.html and img/.
